_help: Optional per-show subtitle rules. Copy this file to subtitle_policy.json (private, never uploaded) and edit it. Shows you follow on the Weekly page can also get a rule there. Modes: official_ok (official streaming subtitles are fine), fansub (fan translations only), fansub_first (fan translations first, official only as a last resort), manual (never automatic; typeset by hand). 'match' is a regular expression tested against the show name; 'imdb' pins the show's IMDb id.
